title: About
text:
I am a Research Statistician, Data Scientist, and Monitoring and Evaluation specialist with experience in applied research, survey methodology, biostatistics, data management, statistical analysis, stakeholder analysis, proposal development, and evidence generation.
My work focuses on using rigorous analytical approaches and data-driven methods to generate evidence that supports research, programme improvement, and decision-making. I have contributed to multidisciplinary research projects spanning survey research, epidemiology, public health, monitoring and evaluation, and programme assessment.





Survey design, sampling, fieldwork monitoring, data quality, and survey operations.



Applied statistical methods, regression modelling, statistical interpretation, and biostatistical analysis.



Programme assessment, indicators, performance measurement, and evidence generation.



Data analysis, visualization, analytical workflows, and data-driven applications.



Stakeholder mapping, stakeholder analysis, and political economy assessment.



Scientific writing, manuscript development, proposal development, and research dissemination.





I have worked across multidisciplinary research teams, contributing to the design, management, analysis, and reporting of research studies. My experience includes working with survey and epidemiological data, supporting data quality processes, conducting statistical analyses, developing analytical outputs, contributing to scientific manuscripts, and supporting research dissemination.
My project experience includes multi-country HPV vaccination research, integrated serosurveillance in Kenya, and political economy and value-for-money analysis of HIV prevention and service delivery programmes.



I am particularly interested in connecting sound statistical methods with practical research and programme questions. I value analytical rigour, reproducibility, clear communication, and the responsible use of data to generate evidence that can inform decisions.
I am also interested in the growing role of data science and artificial intelligence in research and evidence generation, particularly where these technologies can improve efficiency, strengthen analytical workflows, and make complex information more accessible.
